d:
From the haunted caves of Okinawa and UFO sightings near Fukushima to the legendary forests of Transylvania, the search for the unexplained takes the team across the world. Phil and Jess investigate reports of restless spirits, mysterious creatures and encounters that challenge what we know. Their journey also leads them to an abandoned asylum in Detroit and the wilderness of Britain and Alaska, where every investigation brings a new mystery to light. How far will they go to uncover the truth?
Watch Expedition X, Season 4, Episodes 16, 15, 14, 12, 13, 11 and 10, on Discovery Channel India.
